question: If cosec A = sec B, where A and B are acute angles, then what is the value of (A + B)?
solution:
**Given:**

cosec A = sec B

**Concept used:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/76d7969a027a4d853d48c41e4f277dd7e00af268911d88cba2f3f488a47d3a96.png] 

**Calculation:**

cosec A = sec B

⇒ cosec A = cosec(90° - B)

⇒ A = (90° - B)

⇒ A + B = 90°

**∴ The value of (A + B) is 90°.**
